description: Convergence of Climate-Health Vulnerabilities is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Carolinas Integrated Sciences and Assessments; Southeast Regional Climate Center; North Carolina DHHS, Climate and Health Program. The site provides summaries of climate impacts and vulnerable populations, and tools that give users a way to explore the intersection of climate and health. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, High Winds, Severe Winter Weather. Assets: Critical Facilities, People. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
